name: Big Bend National Park
policyReason: Your pet can only go where your car can go; no trails, off-road areas or the river.
summary: Your pet can only go where your car can go; no trails, off-road areas or the river.

excerpts.quote: Your pet can only go where your car can go.
Activities with pets are limited in Big Bend: they are not allowed on trails, off roads, or along the river.

dogRules.text: Not on trails, off roads or on the river.
No more than 30 feet from a road, picnic area or campground.
Pets cannot cross into Mexico at Boquillas.
No pets at the hot springs.
